nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for the end-to-end agentic perturb-seq lifecycle; re-exports the frozen DTOs (ExecutedProposal, ExecutedValidation, LifecycleRun, LifecycleStep) from types.py.

nodes.name: architect_dispatch.py
nodes.summary: Translates the Architect agent's proposed configuration into a concrete backbone choice plus fully-populated hyperparameter dict, canonicalising backbone aliases and applying the Validator's critique delta from the previous round.

nodes.name: resolve_architect_config
nodes.summary: Merges a raw Architect proposal with module defaults and an optional validator critique delta, returning a config dict with backbone, hvg_count, learning_rate, ridge_lambda, epochs, n_agents and n_rounds; unknown backbones fall back to linear.

nodes.name: dispatch_architect
nodes.summary: Backward-compatible wrapper that resolves the Architect config and instantiates the chosen backbone, returning a (backbone, name) tuple.

nodes.name: data_curator_exec.py
nodes.summary: Executes the DataCurator agent's QC recipe by applying Seurat-style top-N highly-variable-gene selection to the expression matrix and recording the applied HVG count and mito threshold for reporting.

nodes.name: execute_data_curator
nodes.summary: Selects the n_top_hvg highest-variance gene columns from X (or passes through if fewer genes exist) and returns the filtered matrix, labels, kept gene indices, and execution metadata.

nodes.name: literature_exec.py
nodes.summary: Pass-through executor for the Literature agent that extracts expected up/down-regulated gene lists and pathways from its structured proposal for downstream Validator use.

nodes.name: extract_expected_genes
nodes.summary: Normalises a Literature proposal into a dict of up, down, and pathways lists with empty defaults.

nodes.name: loop.py
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the multi-round propose-execute-critique-refine agentic lifecycle over a perturbation task, dispatching each agent role (DataCurator, Literature, Architect, Trainer, Validator) through its executor and threading the Validator's critique into the next round until acceptance or max_rounds.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a typing.Protocol (AgentPool) for structural subtyping so the production CellForgeAgentPool and the offline MockAgentPool are interchangeable without inheritance.

nodes.name: AgentPool
nodes.summary: Protocol describing any agent pool that can produce a structured proposal for a given role, round, task and refinement context.

nodes.name: MockAgentPool
nodes.summary: Deterministic offline AgentPool used in unit tests; returns seeded stub proposals for each of the five agent roles.

nodes.name: run_agentic_lifecycle
nodes.summary: Runs up to max_rounds of the five-role agentic loop on one task: curates data, resolves the Architect config, builds and trains a backbone, scores it with the Validator gate, records LifecycleSteps, and returns a LifecycleRun with final MSD and agreement.

nodes.name: trainer_exec.py
nodes.summary: Executes the Trainer agent's recipe by translating its proposal into a BackboneTrainConfig, fitting the chosen backbone, and reporting success, error message, wall time and the applied config.

nodes.name: execute_trainer
nodes.summary: Builds a BackboneTrainConfig from the Trainer proposal (top_k_genes, seed, epochs, lr, ridge_lambda), calls backbone.fit inside a try/except, and returns a result dict with timing and applied config.

nodes.name: types.py
nodes.summary: Defines the frozen dataclass DTOs that record one complete lifecycle run: executed proposals, structured validator critiques, validation reports, per-round steps and the aggregate LifecycleRun.
nodes.languageNotes: All carriers are frozen dataclasses (immutable, hashable) rather than Pydantic models so they serialise trivially; the Pydantic mirror lives in proposal_schema.

nodes.name: ExecutedProposal
nodes.summary: Frozen record of an agent's proposal after execution: content, rationale, LLM confidence, artifact path, wall time and success flag.

nodes.name: StructuredCritiqueDTO
nodes.summary: Validator critique payload (failed genes, suggested next config delta, accept reason) consumed by the next round's Architect.

nodes.name: ExecutedValidation
nodes.summary: Validator's scoring report for a trained model: MSD top-k, BioFM agreement, DEG overlap, acceptance flag, rationale and optional critique.

nodes.name: LifecycleStep
nodes.summary: One agent's contribution within one round, including round index, proposal content, rationale, confidence and execution outcome.

nodes.name: LifecycleRun
nodes.summary: Aggregate record of a full multi-round run on one perturbation task with its steps, final MSD, validator agreement, round/agent counts and backbone used.

nodes.name: validator_gate.py
nodes.summary: Implements the Validator agent step: scores a trained backbone on the held-out perturbation via MSD, gates acceptance against a threshold, and emits a heuristic config delta (backbone rotation, lower LR, higher ridge) for the next round's Architect.

nodes.name: suggest_config_delta
nodes.summary: Heuristic troubleshooting prior: returns an empty delta when accepted, rotates the backbone when DEG sign agreement is below 0.5, otherwise lowers the learning rate and, on catastrophic MSD, raises ridge and cuts epochs.

nodes.name: score_and_gate
nodes.summary: Predicts the held-out log-FC with the backbone, computes MSD and DEG sign agreement against observed data, decides acceptance against threshold_msd, and packages an ExecutedValidation with a StructuredCritiqueDTO.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Backbone-predictor registry and package barrel: re-exports the base Protocol, config types and metric helpers, and provides available_backbones()/build_backbone() to instantiate linear, mlp, or scgpt_small backbones by name (the latter only when PyTorch is installed).

nodes.name: available_backbones
nodes.summary: Returns the tuple of backbone names instantiable in the current environment, adding scgpt_small only when torch is importable.

nodes.name: build_backbone
nodes.summary: Factory that instantiates a registered backbone by name, raising ValueError for unknown names and ImportError for scgpt_small without PyTorch.

nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Shared contract for backbone predictors: the BackbonePredictor Protocol, the BackboneTrainConfig/BackboneFitArtifacts dataclasses, and numpy helpers for per-perturbation means, log fold change and top-k mean squared deviation.
nodes.languageNotes: BackbonePredictor is a typing.Protocol so experiment runners depend on structural typing rather than a base class; concrete backbones never subclass it.

nodes.name: BackboneTrainConfig
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass of per-fit training knobs: top_k_genes, seed, max_iter, learning_rate, ridge_lambda.

nodes.name: BackboneFitArtifacts
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing a completed fit: backbone name, number of training perturbations, train seconds and extra metadata.

nodes.name: BackbonePredictor
nodes.summary: Protocol every backbone must satisfy: a name attribute, fit() over log-normalised expression with perturbation labels and control mask, and predict_logfc() returning the per-gene log-FC vector for a held-out perturbation.

nodes.name: mean_squared_deviation
nodes.summary: Computes mean squared deviation between predicted and observed log-FC, optionally restricted to top-k gene indices.

nodes.name: per_perturbation_mean
nodes.summary: Averages expression across cells for each perturbation label, returning a label-to-mean-vector mapping.

nodes.name: log_fold_change
nodes.summary: Computes pseudocount-stabilised log fold change between perturbed and control mean expression vectors.

nodes.name: linear.py
nodes.summary: Pure-numpy ridge-style linear backbone, the cheapest member of the backbone family: predicts a held-out perturbation's log-FC as the training-mean log-FC pattern plus a target-gene-specific dip learned from training knockdowns.

nodes.name: LinearBackbone
nodes.summary: Fits the mean log-FC pattern and target-gene dip from training perturbations in under 100 ms and returns that pattern (with the dip applied at the target index) for any held-out perturbation.

nodes.name: mlp.py
nodes.summary: Minimal numpy-only two-layer tanh MLP backbone trained with momentum SGD; featurises each perturbation by gene-context one-hots and target-gene mean expression to predict per-gene log-FC as a non-linear step up from the linear baseline.

nodes.name: MLPBackbone
nodes.summary: Two-layer MLP (hidden_dim default 16) with hand-written forward/backward passes; fit() builds features via _featurize and trains with SGD+momentum, predict_logfc() returns the network output for a target gene.

nodes.name: scgpt_small.py
nodes.summary: From-scratch small scGPT-like transformer backbone (gene-as-token embedding, rank-value bins, 4x128-dim encoder, ~2.1M params) with masked-expression pretraining and a LoRA perturbation head; imports lazily so the module loads without PyTorch.
nodes.languageNotes: Guards PyTorch with importlib.util.find_spec at import time (HAS_TORCH) and only imports torch inside fit(), so the registry can be imported in torch-free environments.

nodes.name: SCGPTSmallBackbone
nodes.summary: Transformer backbone that bins expression into rank buckets, builds a MicroTransformer on the fly in fit(), learns target-gene embeddings from training perturbations, and pads predictions back to the full gene space in predict_logfc().
